Expose handling limits while the formulation set is still exploratory.
Keep the reason for selection with the recipe card.

slides.title: A decision-led workflow
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Intake: material and context
bullets: Ashley King coordinates receipt and allocation.
Supply identity, physical form, material-lot relationship and available mass.
Tell us whether the same material condition will be used in the next preparation.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Intended use sets the comparison
bullets: Dose and administration volume determine the loading question.
Dilution medium and hold conditions determine relevant stress.
Exposure use and product storage require different evidence.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Screen concentration in mg/mL
bullets: State whether concentration refers to dissolved material or total dispersion loading.
Keep the target distinct from measured equilibrium capacity.
Do not carry a nominal concentration into a solution claim after precipitation.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Loading and excipient burden
bullets: Use weight percent when describing excipient loading.
Solvent support can change apparent preparation feasibility.
bullets_right: Viscosity may limit mixing and withdrawal.
Dilution can reverse an apparent concentrate advantage.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Vehicle ladder preparation
bullets: Define recipe composition and addition order.
Capture wetting, mixing and initial appearance on the bench sheet.
Preserve unsuccessful preparations so later changes have context.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Vehicle ladder observation
bullets: Compare initial, standing and post-dilution behavior.
Record whether sediment recovers under the intended mixing step.
Interpret capacity beside handling rather than choosing on a solubility ranking alone.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Dilution follow-up
bullets: Use the medium relevant to the intended administration step.
Keep the concentrate recipe linked to the diluted observation.
A failure requires a revised vehicle or dosing approach, followed by the relevant comparison.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Excipient compatibility screen design
bullets: Agree candidate excipients and material condition.
Choose observation conditions that answer the development question.
Separate compatibility screening from a product stability commitment.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Screen suitability before recommendation

rows: Visible failure retained in the interpretation

slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Particle-size decisions in µm
bullets: Use measured distributions when numerical size limits are required.
Consider wetting, sediment strength and redispersion beside size.
A finer material is not automatically easier to dose or manufacture.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Manufacturability limits
bullets: Mixing and addition sequence may be volume-dependent.
Container geometry can affect sediment recovery.
bullets_right: Material loss can change practical preparation yield.
A small exploratory preparation does not establish a reproducible larger process.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Exploratory output: what you receive
bullets: Bench sheets with recipe identity and observations.
Development note explaining selection and rejected routes.
Recipe card with preparation and handling instructions for the defined use.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Pilot-lot scale gate
bullets: Agree preparation volume, mixing method and hold condition.
Identify differences from the exploratory preparation before execution.
Carry exceptions forward so the receiving team can recognize a changed outcome.
slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Receiving-team handoff criteria — revised v3

rows: Composition and sequence are reproducible locally
Lot and physical form match the intended use
Resuspension and withdrawal can be performed
Failure to recover or changed appearance triggers escalation

slides.footer: Durnesswick Laboratories Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Commitments at the next scale gate
bullets: Screening concentration, loading and handling claims apply to the examined conditions.
Process lock, storage claims and dose uniformity require their own evidence.
Share the next preparation question with Julia Carver; agree the work package before expanding use.
